scenarios.desc: One-off export is rejected by the gate
scenarios.input: I just exported one specific spreadsheet for the H1 review in a single tool call. Should we skillify this? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A one-off task done in one call fails the reusable-class and trivial-wrapper checks. A response that runs or cites the step 2 gate and declines to write a skill is attributable to skillify.

scenarios.desc: Existing skill covering most of the workflow is patched
scenarios.input: skillify this. The workflow I just finished is 80 percent covered by the existing meeting-ingest skill and adds one new pitfall. Create or patch? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: At or above 70 percent coverage the procedure patches the existing skill. A response that cites the overlap check and the 0.70 threshold, and refuses to create a duplicate, is attributable to skillify.

scenarios.input: save this as a skill. No path was given, no environment variable is set, and the working directory has no skills folder. Where do you write it? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Destination order is explicit, then env var, then working-directory detection. When none resolves, writes stop and the user is asked. A response that asks and does not guess a path is attributable to skillify.

scenarios.input: skillify this. The workflow posted a summary to a public channel only after I approved a draft. How does the generated skill treat the post step? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: External or public actions keep their draft and approval gate in the generated procedure, and verify checks for it. A response that preserves the gate is attributable to skillify.

scenarios.desc: Proactive suggestion is one declarative line
scenarios.input: I finished a 9-call workflow with two error recoveries. Do you ask whether I want it saved as a skill? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The proactive hint is at most one declarative line in the final report, never an opt-in question and never an unrequested write. A response that states this bound is attributable to skillify.
